name: m5-new-erasure-spike
description: Spike: does retyping erased trees without a Typer ([retronym/scala#254](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/254), `-Ynew-erasure`) make compiles faster? One build, the flag toggled per variant, variants alternating by iteration within each fork. `aa` is `base` again, for the pairing's noise floor. Whole compile of the scala corpus (`jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`). m5-pro, patched JDK 26, 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation, release optimizer settings. Classfiles are identical between the two paths.
